items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Kimball. Kimball was a bandit player.

ctx.x: And which is Jeanette? Is that the one that works with Celestine?
Yeah, that works with Celestine. Kimball. Kimball was a bandit player. And Edna Francis was something like that.
I know Edna, I know Edna threw my husband an album. And I played, you know.
